item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years. We believe this technology can accelerate science, medicine, and growth on a historic scale—and we’re working to help make that future possible.

2. We believe that if superintelligent AI arrives within the next 20 years, the global economy will at least double in the decade that follows. That is the scale of transformation we’re preparing for—and why protecting frontier research matters.

3. If we build superintelligent AI within the next two decades, global economic output will at least double within the ten years after. We’re committed to advancing frontier AI so its extraordinary potential can drive progress in science, medicine, and the economy.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years. That transformation could reshape how quickly we make scientific discoveries, develop medicines, and create prosperity. It is a future of extraordinary promise—and one that calls for serious work today. We are building toward artificial general intelligence and, ultimately, superintelligence, while working to protect the frontier research that makes progress possible. We believe the United States must lead in this technology, and we are committed to helping ensure that leadership translates into broad gains. In this issue, we share what we are doing to advance that work.
